question: Bismillah Khan played which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bismillah Khan** was a renowned Indian classical musician who played the **shehnai.**
 
• His expressive virtuosity in playing it led to his rise to prominence as a prominent** Hindustani classical music artist.**
 
• The **woodwind instrument **was inextricably linked to his name.
 
• The **shehnai **is a traditional Indian wind instrument that is similar to an **oboe.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A sitar** is a stringed instrument that is played by plucking the strings.

 
 
• **Ravi Shankar **is a famous sitar player from India.
 
 
 
• **The tabla **is a percussion instrument that consists of two drums of different sizes.
 
 
• **Ustad Allah Rakha **is a famous tabla player from India.
 
 
 
• **Harmonium** is a keyboard instrument that produces sound by blowing air through reeds.
 
 
• **Pandit Rambhau Bijapure** is a famous harmonium player from India.
